overview_description.description: FlowManual provides an AI document analysis platform for construction contractors that focuses on back office workflows. The platform reads bids, contracts, vendor quotes, invoices, specs, and submittals to surface changes in scope, price, deadlines, and exclusions directly on the source line. It offers comparison tools for bid-to-contract and buyout-to-invoice review, along with scope gap detection and change order analysis. FlowManual also supports drafting RFIs, generating first-pass estimates from equipment schedules, and reviewing submittals against specifications. The service includes hosted cloud and self-hosted deployment options and emphasizes encryption, access controls, and audit logging for sensitive construction documents.
